guardrails: 2025 actual crop is never used to define an expected 2025 beet slot
ring-state uses only t-2 and t-1 clean history
established-beet status uses only years before target year
same-slot-repeat uses only earlier raps->winter-wheat->sugar-beet triplets
2019-2024 are placebo comparison years; 2017 Bjuv shock is excluded
this tests a contract-shock signature, not farmer intent or causal attribution
